SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS PO_LINE_ID, COUNT(KEY_2) AS LEGACY_COUNT FROM XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RFQ' AND KEY_9 = '*' GROUP BY KEY_1
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT NVL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, NVL(ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(END_DATE,' ') AS CLOSE_DATE, NVL(QUOTATION_NO,' ') AS QUOTATION_NO, NVL(QUOTATION_SEQ,' ') AS QUOTATION_SEQ, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(DESCRIPTION,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(UNIT_MEASURE,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(MAKER_NAME,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, NVL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(RD_DATE, ' ') AS RD_DATE, NVL(TO_CHAR(PO_LINE_ID), 0) AS REF_IF_NO, LAST_NAME AS REQ_USER_NAME, EMAIL_ADDRESS AS REQ_USER_MAIL, OFFICE_PHONE, MOBILE_PHONE, OFFICE_PHONE||' '||MOBILE_PHONE AS REQ_USER_TEL 'N' AS LEGACY_END_YN, '$G_RS.LEGACY_COUNT$' AS LEGACY_COUNT FROM KEPRFQ, XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RFQ' AND KEY_1 = TO_CHAR(PO_LINE_ID) AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.PO_LINE_ID$' AND KEY_9 = '*' ORDER BY QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ) UNION ALL SELECT '' AS STATUS, '' AS ADD_DATE, '' AS CLOSE_DATE, '' AS QUOTATION_NO, '' AS QUOTATION_SEQ, '' AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, '' AS DESCRIPTION, '' AS UNIT_MEASURE, '' AS MAKER_NAME, '' AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, '' AS RD_DATE, KEY_1 AS REF_IF_NO, '' AS REQ_USER_NAME, '' AS REQ_USER_MAIL, '' AS OFFICE_PHONE, '' AS MOBILE_PHONE, '' AS REQ_USER_TEL, 'Y' AS LEGACY_END_YN, '$G_RS.LEGACY_COUNT$' AS LEGACY_COUNT FROM XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RFQ' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.PO_LINE_ID$' AND KEY_9 = '*' GROUP BY KEY_1
UPDATE XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RFQ' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.PO_LINE_ID$' AND KEY_9 = '*'
UPDATE XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'E', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RFQ' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.PO_LINE_ID$' AND KEY_9 = '*'
